data.title: Mastering Totals with Tax and Tip
data.description: Practice calculating added tip and tax amounts, and find the final totals on extended percent bars for real-world financial scenarios.

challenges.scenario: A store buys an item for $40 and adds a 18% markup.
challenges.question: Step 1 — the markup: what percent of the cost is the markup? Place it on the bar.

steps.prompt: Step 1 — the markup: what percent of the cost is the markup? Place it on the bar.
steps.hint: The markup rate is stated in the scenario — 18%. Place 18%; the value shows it in dollars.

steps.prompt: Step 2 — the total: including the markup, the total is what percent of the cost? Place the TOTAL on the bar.
steps.hint: Add the markup to the whole: 100% + 18% = 118%.

challenges.hint: The markup rate is stated in the scenario — 18%. Place 18%; the value shows it in dollars.
